planning_notes: A dedicated serial receive requirement is added via serial_command_input (CLK/DIO tokens with the integer codes from the provided serial inventory). Outgoing serial_channels cannot replace receiving.

The requirement mentions RTC current time provided via serial input but does not specify the exact command payload/format beyond CLK/DIO tokens; SysML must interpret the receive events accordingly to update 'current time' state and reminder schedule.
Exact HH:MM display format and how three reminder times are shown during browsing (while digit formatting/colon behavior is not specified for TM1637 here) must be handled in the model.

Button electrical polarity and whether pullups are used are not explicitly provided; digital_input uses catalog defaults unless the circuit facts establish otherwise. If the buttons are wired active-low with pullups, model/button logic must account for that.

The original requirement states sending fixed text 'missed dose' on the serial warning. The provided contract only reports a typed numeric missed-dose count. If exact fixed text with no number is mandatory, add serial_text_output with text='missed dose' under the same trigger; this proposal keeps the unchanged numeric report because the prior contract did not include the fixed-text requirement in wiring.

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: LED status indicator (blink on missed/active reminder wait)

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer intermittent alarm tone (model controls enable/duration)

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: 7-segment display content (steady show current time; cleared/updated by model)

interfaces.name: io_6
interfaces.meaning: RTC time source via serial: update current time using command tokens CLK/DIO (mapping per source inventory)

interfaces.name: io_6_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Serial report gate: when a missed dose warning event occurs (30s not confirmed)

interfaces.name: serial_0_value_0
interfaces.meaning: Cumulative missed dose count reported after 'missed dose' warning

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个智能药盒提醒系统，使用 RTC 模拟时间源（通过串口输入当前时间）、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）、按钮 D2、D3、D4、蜂鸣器 D6 和 LED D13。系统支持设置三个服药提醒时刻，数码管平时显示当前时间；到达提醒时间时蜂鸣器间歇鸣叫、LED 闪烁，并等待用户通过按钮确认。若 30 秒内未确认则通过串口输出 missed dose 警告并累计漏服次数，按钮可浏览今日提醒状态。
